The '''Ukio system''', also known as the '''Ukian system''', was located in the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Its primary [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]], a major producer of foodstuffs. The system contained a [[Ukio system's star|star]].

It was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] sought by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] during his campaign against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], less for tactical reasons than for the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] it contained.
